title: Pawprint Data Patrol
tagline: A pawsitively tiny game from PostHog

music.mood: playful, bouncy, a bit sneaky, cartoon office

text.win: Every walk logged, every booking counted, no crashes swept under the rug. Good dev. Very good dev.
text.lose: Some muddy data got through the dog flap. Have a treat and try again.
text.credits: Made with love (and dog puns) for Pawprint by PostHog

days.intro: Welcome to the pack! Only events from our tracking plan get a treat. Sniff out the typos.

rules.text: Flag events that aren't in the tracking plan

days.intro: The QA team walks fake dogs on the beta build. Those bookings aren't real.

rules.text: Flag events from beta or the emulator

days.intro: Walkers rate from 1 to 5 stars. Someone gave 11. We love the enthusiasm, but no.
Crash reports without a screen are useless. And bookings need a service. Obviously.

rules.text: service must be walk, sitting or daycare

days.intro: Board meeting tomorrow. No double-counted bookings, no time-travelling dogs.

rules.text: Flag IDs you've already seen today
Flag events stamped in the future

final_record.intro: One last booking before the board meeting. It wags its tail. Suspiciously.
